steps.details: Verified active guidelines for LumaDesk with terminology and claims rules
Draft created with non-compliant copy "Lumadesk guarantees 10x..."
Detected 5 findings including 3 blockers preventing publication
Inspected authoritative quotes in drawer; applied verified replacement text
Saved Revision #2 with parent rev-001; verified LCS word diff
Re-analysis verified: 0 blockers remain in revision #2
Transitioned campaign to IN_REVIEW with assigned reviewer
Recorded decision APPROVED by reviewer with required 10+ char rationale
Exported tamper-proof package with verified SHA-256 hash matching approved revision

checks.name: Skip to Main Content Link
checks.details: App.tsx implements Skip to main content with visible focus ring on Tab.

checks.name: Modal Dialog Keyboard Dismissal (Escape)
checks.details: All modal dialogs (EvidenceDrawer, DecisionModal, ExportModal, SubmitReviewModal, ResolutionModal, BrandInsightsModal, AmbiguityReportModal, ConflictResolutionModal) implement keydown listeners for Escape.

checks.name: Dialog ARIA Modality & Labelling
checks.details: Modals implement role="dialog", aria-modal="true", and aria-labelledby pointing to their respective heading titles.

checks.name: Non-Colour Reliance for Status Badges
checks.details: SeverityBadge, CheckStatusChip, and State badges use explicit uppercase text labels (BLOCKER, WARNING, ADVISORY, APPROVED, STALE) accompanied by icons and ARIA labels, meeting WCAG 1.4.1.

checks.name: Explicit Form Labels & Required Indicators
checks.details: All form controls in intake, decision, rationale, and policy dialogs have paired <label htmlFor="..."> with required markers and character length counters.

checks.name: 200% Zoom & 320px Reflow (WCAG 1.4.10)
checks.details: Layout uses CSS Grid with minmax(340px, 1fr) and flex-wrap on header action toolbars; collapses cleanly to single column without horizontal page scrolling at 200% zoom or 320px width.

checks.name: Focus-Visible Rings on Interactive Elements
checks.details: CSS provides universal :focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; } for all buttons, inputs, links, and filter tabs.

checks.name: Accessible Alert Announcements
checks.details: <Alert> component implements role="alert" with aria-live="assertive" for immediate assistive technology feedback on API or validation failures.

tests.name: Explicit Denominator Disclosure
tests.details: Denominator definition verified: "Distinct content items with at least one completed terminal analysis run"

tests.name: Zero Denominator Null Rate Safety
tests.details: Verified that a denominator of 0 returns null for confirmed_per_reviewed_item, preventing division by zero.

tests.name: Item-Level Deduplication of Repeated Analyses
tests.details: Evaluated repeated runs across items; successfully deduplicated re-analyses using item-level denominator.

tests.name: Ambiguity Report Deduplication
tests.details: Deduplicated repeated reports from the same actor on the same rule/revision.

checks.name: Uniform API Error Envelope
checks.details: All error responses conform to { code, message, request_id, details } schema.

checks.name: CSRF Mutation Header Protocol
checks.details: client.ts: Mutations (POST, PUT, DELETE) send x-csrf-token from in-memory session; never stored in localStorage.

checks.name: Session Cookie Isolation
checks.details: Transport uses credentials: "same-origin"; client never reads the session cookie directly, satisfying OWASP.

checks.name: Mock Transport Production Isolation
checks.details: Mock transport registration in main.tsx is strictly guarded by `import.meta.env.DEV && import.meta.env.VITE_USE_MOCK_API === "true"`, guaranteeing zero mock code in production bundles.

checks.name: HTTP Status Code Coverage
checks.details: Client and UI implement distinct handling for 200, 201, 204, 401, 403, 404, 409, 422, 429 including 409 stale revision rebasing.

tests.name: Emoji Multibyte Code Point Replacement
tests.details: Safely extracted target word and replaced with LumaDesk preserving leading ✨ and trailing 🚀 without surrogate pair truncation.

tests.name: Diacritical Mark & NFC Normalization Safety
tests.details: Normalized text produces stable code point slicing without splitting accent diacritics.

tests.name: Zero-Width Joiner (ZWJ) Boundary Preservation
tests.details: Preserved complex multi-part ZWJ emoji sequence (👨‍💻) before targeted brand replacement.
